title: Social Content
summary: Drafts social posts, threads, carousels and short-form video scripts, plans a content calendar, repurposes long content, and builds a daily list of posts to comment on, all as drafts for the user to post.
changes: Renamed from social to social-content, rewrote the description (no scheduling), removed the metadata/version key
Removed the Scheduling Best Practices section and the Publishing From Your Agent section (posting/scheduling through MCP or APIs)

Added one line that every post, comment, reply and DM is a draft for the user, who publishes or schedules it; engagement routine and batching steps now hand drafts to the user; "Schedule across" became "Plan across"
Moved the Short-Form Video section verbatim into references/short-form-basics.md to keep the body under ~350 lines, leaving a pointer
Replaced the .agents/product-marketing.md path; replaced references to copywriting, cold-email, ad-creative, influencer-marketing and other upstream skills with skills in this library or removed them

references/listening.md: replaced the curl/jq recipes and install steps with a prose list of the same public sources and fields; replaced dev-browser/Playwright instructions with a tool-agnostic logged-in browser session (never entering credentials); replaced .agents/ paths and cp commands
references/listening-sources-template.md: same path, dev-browser and curl replacements
references/short-form-video.md: removed the ad-creative cross-reference; batch step 5 now has the user queue posts
references/reverse-engineering.md: replaced the emoji do/don't markers with "Weak:" and "Strong:"
references/short-form-basics.md: cut the unsourced "captions increase watch time by 25-40%" statistic
